mentions.name: Breaka clubs for kids
mentions.description: This platform runs clubs that teach kids to code and hand-draw their own computer games, currently piloted in schools. Its main experience lets kids build and play their own RPG in the browser on school iPads, built on a fork of the Godot engine tuned for constrained browser devices. It also streams games directly to iPads, including a modded version of Overcooked! 2 that teaches kids to code, delivered via a custom Kubernetes system that spins up game pods on demand backed by time-sliced NVIDIA GPUs, using Cloudflare's TURN relay over TCP since UDP is blocked on school networks.
mentions.problem: Delivering browser games to school iPads on locked-down networks is hard: some iPads crash from memory limits when launching camera views, in-memory web workers are constrained, and blocked UDP rules out direct WebRTC.
mentions.audience: Kids learning to code in school clubs
